scenes.text: A website says one thing and does another. An AI agent is asked one thing and can reach another.
scenes.caption: Two gaps with the same shape: what is said or asked, against what actually happens or is reachable.
say: Cycubix built ConsentScan to measure the first gap.

scenes.caption: 'Installed, not blocking' is Cycubix's phrase for consent platforms. An agent policy that exists but is not enforced has the same shape.
say: The phrase 'installed, not blocking' fits both.

scenes.title: RiskMandate on ConsentScan's agentic workflow
steps: Write the mandate: load, record cookies, Reject, grade
Measure the reach of the scanner and MCP credentials
scenes.caption: Our hypothesis, not their claim. Built from public pages only; nothing of theirs was tested.
say: The scanner's job is narrow, so the mandate is writable.
A narrow mandate makes the gap measurable. Today it is unknown from public pages.

scenes.text: ConsentScan checks what a site says against what it does. We would check what an agent is asked to do against what it can reach.
scenes.caption: Starting with ConsentScan's own scanner and MCP server, as a hypothesis built from public pages only.
say: Cycubix already knows how to measure a gap.
We would measure this one with them.
